pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit entering multiple sequential orders (pyramiding) within a 60-second window on XAUUSD; maximum 1 active position per directional impulse.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a confirmed 5-minute ATR breakout candle closing past the micro-structure key level before triggering market orders, avoiding fakeouts.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively trigger trailing stop-lock or partial harvesting when floating profit crosses +$8.00 to prevent positive runs from evaporating.
